message:
Major refactor, pivot code from SOCK_RAW to SOCK_DGRAM

- One multicast socket for receiving, bound to 239.255.255.250:1900
- One shared unicast/multicast socket for sending reply/notify, bound
  to ifaddr:1900, we also join 239.255.255.250 to ensure we recieve
  M-SEARCH queries on all interfaces, regardless of the routing table
- Move web server to port 1901
- Find all system interface addresses, treat each as a separate
  interface and join 239.255.255.250

Signed-off-by: Joachim Nilsson <troglobit@gmail.com>
